acceptance: Every reused implementation, asset and data corpus has verified applicable permission at its pinned revision. Excluded NeTo/Spec implementations, schemas, descriptors and generated bindings remain unused; no access-denial workaround.
Independently establish rights for embedded sayings/calendar/seed/asset material or use approved original replacement data with an explicit behavior/content-change note.

Execute framework and gateway differential tests for service routes, aliases, constraints, binding defaults, trailing slash, percent encoding, methods/405 and content negotiation. Static attributes alone are insufficient.

Pin every exposed DTO and error shape, null/omission, dictionary casing, enum numbers, GUIDs, decimals, timestamps, content types, headers and validation/exception serialization from permitted evidence.

Recover global authentication/fallback policy, session/claim mapping, permission middleware and anonymous/unavailable behavior from eligible evidence. Synthetic bypasses stay explicit and production defaults deny.

Verify per-resource owner/member/admin/visibility permissions, revocation, role changes, dependency failures and request-scoped identity. No guessed permission strings, numeric roles or real credential issuance.

Pin licensed table/column/default/index/FK and soft-delete/audit behavior for every operation. Use actual disposable PostgreSQL tests for transactions, count/page consistency, isolation, concurrency and restart.

Define transport contracts only from permitted licensed callers or authorized documentation; prove cache/event envelopes, keying, protobuf interoperability, ordering, acknowledgment, retry, idempotency and websocket fanout. Unknown wire details remain blocked.
Validate synthetic object references, streaming, size limits, archive/media handling, quota and ACL behavior, failure cleanup, cancellation and recovery; no production buckets or files.

Test credential/signature state machines only with inert synthetic material. Production key/session/token creation, storage, rotation and revocation require verified policy and separately authorized integration.

Use controlled fixture providers until external API contracts, error handling, signatures, timeouts, idempotency and required account permissions are verified. No live payment, message, federation or account operation during migration tests.
Map every scheduler registration, hosted worker and listener; establish timezone/misfire, leases, cluster behavior, retry/ack, clock boundaries, duplicate execution, restart and catch-up semantics.
Verify defaults and required settings, secret loading, service names/discovery, URLs, ports, serializer settings and config-binding differences; never infer missing shared constants.
Prove synthetic data copy/reconciliation, migration up/down and rollback, dual-write/cutover ownership, connection loss, process crash/restart and bounded operator recovery.

Build actual services/containers; verify health/readiness, TLS, metrics/logs/traces, graceful shutdown, required native media libraries and exact-commit CI/client smoke before any production-ready claim.
